requiredBehavior: Provide a compatible generic process/resource effect contract that accepts bounded memory, swap, process-count and deadline constraints, returns typed raw observations, and exposes an owned cancellable execution handle so MNCS decides stale cancellation and a provider/runtime interrupts the process tree and reports cleanup.
summary: Profile 0.18 process_run supports explicit bounded argv, environment, capture, and a deadline, but has no typed cgroup resource envelope or source-visible handle for interrupting an already-running external process. Structured task/scope cancellation stops pending work, while process_run completes synchronously.
title: Process effects lack aggregate resource envelopes and in-flight cancellation handles
